LightningComponentBundle.description: [Mintel UI] Big buttons for frequent actions: flows, quick actions, links or events.

property.name: actions
property.label: Actions (Label | icon | flow/action/url/event | target; …)
property.default: New task | utility:task | action | Global.NewTask; Log a call | utility:call | action | Global.LogACall; Help | utility:help | url | https://help.salesforce.com
property.description: Buttons separated by semicolons. Type: flow (target = Flow API name; opens it with recordId), action (target = quick action API name, e.g. Global.NewTask or Case.LogACall; a name without a dot uses this page's object), url (target = a URL), event (target = any name; for a parent LWC).
